questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

If I were he (1)/ I wouldn’t (2)/ accept the offer. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. 'No error'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The given sentence is a conditional sentence of **'Imaginary sentence'.**

 
• The conditional sentences are those sentences in which condition is given in the** 'If'** clause.** 'If' **clause is a subordinate clause and there is one main clause.
 
• The structure of imaginary sentences in a conditional sentences are **'If + Subject + present subjunctive mood (were) + Object + Main clause.'**
 
• **In this sentence,** **'I'** is a subject and '**were' is a linking verb** hence we need to write a subject complement it should be noun/pronoun/adjective and In this case subject complement should agree with the subject. Hence, that's why** 'he' is written not 'him.'**
 
• **Let's see an example:**
 
 
• If I were he I would think twice before cutting his hair.
 
 

**So the correct sentence is:**

*If I were he I wouldn't accept the offer.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

Neeta has served as the President (1)/ of the Oshinara club (2)/ since ten years. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** option (3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The part (3) **"since ten years"** is **Incorrect**. It should be "for ten years."
 
• **Since **is used to indicate a point of time.
 
 
• **For example: **He has been suffering since Monday.
 
 
 
• **For** is used to indicate a course of time.
 
 
• For example: He has been suffering for 2 days.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 3.**

Therefore the correct sentence is *Neeta has served as the President of the Oshinara club **for ten years.***

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence is given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Only last week _____ she die.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **did**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **correct auxiliary verb** to use with the past simple tense is 'did'.
 
• The sentence is structured to emphasize the action by using the auxiliary verb **'did'** followed by the base form of the main verb, which is **not provided** in the sentence but implied to be 'die'.
 
• The use of **'did'** is appropriate for questions, negatives, and emphatic statements in the past simple tense.
 
• The correct sentence structure for past simple emphatic statements or questions often starts with 'did' followed by the subject and the base form of the verb.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Only last week **did she die**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Has'** and **'have'** are auxiliary verbs used in the present perfect tense, which is not suitable for the past action described in the sentence.
 
• **'Had'** is an auxiliary verb used in the past perfect tense, indicating an action that occurred before another past action, which is not the context here.
